investment_thesis.summary: Griffin invests at the intersection of content, social platforms, and software infrastructure. The firm focuses exclusively on the gaming ecosystem with a mission to be the definitive source of capital for the games industry.
investment_thesis.ai_alignment: Strong alignment with AI/live service infrastructure. Griffin's portfolio includes Discord, Overwolf, and AppLovin - all infrastructure plays that enable live service games. Peter Levin's background in interactive ventures and digital strategy makes the fund highly receptive to AI-powered game infrastructure.

outreach_angle: Griffin's infrastructure thesis and portfolio (Discord, Overwolf, AppLovin) demonstrates deep conviction in game enablement platforms. Position our AI infrastructure as the next evolution of their existing thesis - enabling live service games through intelligent automation, content generation, and player engagement systems. Reference Peter's Lionsgate digital strategy background and emphasize scalable infrastructure for modern game operations.
notes: Griffin is one of the world's largest gaming-focused VC funds. Co-founded by Peter Levin (ex-Lionsgate, Nerdist), Phil Sanderson (23+ years gaming VC), and Nick Tuosto (M&A advisory). Strong track record with exits including investments in Discord and AppLovin.
